# Noir & Co.

> Considered luxury design for the everyday atelier. Modern luxury apparel, accessories, and curated home collections.

Noir & Co. is a luxury retail and atelier brand creating elevated wardrobe essentials, crafted accessories, and refined homeware. Sourced responsibly and designed to endure.

## Documentation & Storefront
- [Storefront](/): Homepage featuring new arrivals, editorial drops, and curated categories
- [Catalogue](/store): Complete shopping catalogue with live filtering, stock status, and pricing
- [Collections](/collections): Limited atelier releases, capsule edits, and seasonal series
- [Search](/search): Real-time product search across all collections and categories
- [Shopping Bag](/cart): Customer shopping bag and order review
- [Mobile Application](/download/app): Direct download for the Noir native iOS and Android application
